members.name: value
members.doc: The value, when the caller controls it.

members.name: defaultValue
members.doc: The starting value, when the slider controls itself.

members.name: min
members.doc: The smallest value the thumb can take.

members.name: max
members.doc: The largest value the thumb can take.

members.name: step
members.doc: How far one arrow key press moves the value, and the increment the value snaps to.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Disables the slider: it can be neither focused nor changed.

members.name: readOnly
members.doc: Makes the slider read-only: it stays focusable but its value cannot be changed.

members.name: orientation
members.doc: The direction of the track.

members.name: name
members.doc: The form field name. A named slider submits its value.

members.name: onChange
members.doc: Called with the new value each time it changes while the thumb moves. A disabled or read-only slider does not call it.

members.name: onChangeEnd
members.doc: Called with the current value when an interaction ends, such as a key press or a drag release, even when the value did not move. A disabled or read-only slider does not call it.

members.name: label
members.doc: The visible label, which also names the slider. Without one, the slider needs an aria-label or aria-labelledby, and an empty label does not count.
